feeds.title: Chantelle the Coach Blog
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Chantelle. I'm a trained & certified Jay Shetty Certified Life & Success Coach operating as a Single Life Empowerment Coach. I love to help singles get confident in their single life so they can stop stressing about their relationship status and start actually enjoying their single life!

feeds.title: Unmarried Equality Blog
feeds.description: Unmarried Equality advocates for equality and fairness for unmarried people, including people who are single, choose not to marry, cannot marry, or live together before marriage. They provide support and information through their blog for this fast-growing constituency, fight discrimination on the basis of marital status, and educate the public and policymakers about relevant social and economic issues.

feeds.title: Michal B.L Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog! Where I write about single life in all its glory and share Single Life Lessons to help you embrace singlehood. I offer tips and advice for a better, happy single life. How to be independent, feel comfortable in your own skin and company, and how not chase toxic people.

feeds.title: Good Bachelorhood
feeds.description: Good Bachelorhood is a blog by a retired fellow who likes to pontificate about a single life. I speak from a man's perspective; women are welcome but may occasionally be offended.

feeds.title: Still Searching for Prince Charming » Single Life
feeds.description: When I'm not searching for Prince Charming, I'm writing; specializing in women's health, sex tech, and erotic scripts. Also, read about living a single life in this segment of the blog.

feeds.title: The Happy Bachelor Blog
feeds.description: My name is Craig Wynne, and I'm a writer and professor at the University of the District of Columbia. And I'm also a happy bachelor. Being a happy bachelor is a skill that didn't come easily to me. This site will provide my own observations, anecdotes, advice, and takes on all things related to singlehood.

feeds.title: The Single Supplement
feeds.description: Because single people deserve a newsletter of their own

feeds.title: Living Single in Retirement
feeds.description: Hello and welcome. Linda here. I'm also a single, retired woman. I've always had a passion for helping others, that's probably the nurse in me. My website is about sharing with ladies who are single, divorced, or widowed and who are interested in ways to create a better retirement life.

feeds.title: Solo Living
feeds.description: Solo Living is the original and leading voice talking about the living alone and single life experience. We are changing perceptions around what has been a misunderstood way of life. Solo Living is a community-driven manual dedicated to the modern living alone experience and to people navigating life solo

feeds.title: Forgetting Fairytales » Single Life
feeds.description: Blog posts for singles, helping you to deal with your breakup, get over your ex, become happy being single, and learn to love single life! Forgetting Fairytales is a Specialist Breakup, Dating, and Relationship blog that focuses on helping you become the person you really want to be and attract (then keep!) the love you really deserve.

feeds.title: First Person Singular
feeds.description: FIRST PERSON SINGULAR is a guide to surviving, thriving, and sometimes just getting through a single day created by Wendy Braitman.

feeds.title: The Awkward Spinster
feeds.description: Fawn Kemble is a 40-something single Christian geek girl. A nerd from day one, she was born to Christian artists and teachers and spent her life trying to navigate the rough seas of the modern American church. She is a Library Associate and Storytime Lady at the city library by day, and a freelance counselor by night.

feeds.title: It's All About Balance
feeds.description: April's current titles/labels include the following: full-time paralegal, full-time autonomous mother of two teenaged daughters, chauffeur/commuter, personal finance junkie, and blogger. April finds her balance of it all by blogging here. April resides in Los Angeles(ish), CA.

feeds.title: She's Single Magazine
feeds.description: She's Single Magazine is a platform celebrating single life, empowering women to embrace their independence and navigate the complexities of relationships and self-discovery. Through articles, interviews, and features, it offers insights, advice, and inspiration on topics ranging from dating and self-care to career and personal growth. With a supportive community, it fosters connection and solidarity among single women, promoting confidence and fulfillment in their individual journeys.
